title: Sick leave documentation
content: Employees must submit a medical certificate for sick leave exceeding 3 days. Short-term self-certified sick leave is allowed up to 4 times per year.

title: How to check remaining leave days
content: If you want to check how many leave days you have left, just tell me your Employee ID and I’ll look it up for you.

title: Login fails for finance users
content: Several users in the finance department cannot log in. They receive an 'authentication failed' message even though their passwords were recently reset.

title: App is slow in the morning
content: Users report that the internal sales application becomes extremely slow between 08:00 and 10:00. Performance issues appeared after the last deployment.

title: Code of conduct
content: Employees are expected to maintain professional behavior, follow company values, and treat colleagues with respect.

title: How to update personal information
content: Go to the Employee Profile page and update your address, phone number, and emergency contacts.

title: How to connect to VPN
content: Install the corporate VPN client, log in with your employee credentials, and verify the connection using multi-factor authentication.

title: Can I work from abroad?
content: Working from abroad requires approval from HR and may require tax and legal assessment depending on the country.

title: Email not syncing on mobile
content: Ensure that your device is enrolled in Mobile Device Management and that the Outlook app has sync permissions enabled.

title: Information security policy
content: Employees must use strong passwords, lock devices when unattended, and report suspicious activity immediately.

title: Where to find company policies?
content: Company policies are available in the Policy Center under the HR Portal. All employees have access.

title: Health and safety policy
content: Employees must follow workplace safety procedures and report hazards or incidents immediately.

title: Working hours and attendance
content: Employees are expected to follow their contracted working hours. Any changes or absences must be communicated to the manager.

title: Company remote work policy
content: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week. Exceptions require written approval from the department manager.

title: Device usage policy
content: Company laptops and mobile devices must be used for business purposes only. Installing unapproved software is not permitted.

title: Remote work policy
content: Employees may request remote work arrangements in line with business needs. Long-term remote work requires approval from the department manager.

title: Equal employment opportunity policy
content: The company provides equal opportunities to all employees and applicants. Discrimination or harassment is strictly prohibited.

title: Maternity and paternity leave rules
content: Employees are entitled to parental leave according to national legislation. Applications should be submitted at least one month before the expected date.

title: Why is my payslip missing?
content: Payslips are published on the 25th of each month. If your payslip is missing, check if your bank details are updated in the HR system.

title: Unexpected logout after inactivity
content: Users are being logged out after only 5 minutes of inactivity. Default timeout is supposed to be 30 minutes.

title: How to request new hardware
content: Submit a ticket through the IT Service Desk. Standard delivery times are 5–7 business days depending on hardware availability.

title: How to request annual leave
content: Open the HR Portal, go to Leave Requests, choose the dates, select the leave type, and submit for approval.

title: Security best practices
content: All employees must enable multi-factor authentication, use strong passwords, and report phishing emails immediately.

title: Probation period guidelines
content: The standard probation period is six months. Performance evaluations are conducted at month 3 and month 6.

title: Password expiration rules
content: Passwords must be changed every 90 days. A notification is automatically sent 10 days before expiration.

title: Travel and expenses policy
content: Business travel must be pre-approved. Expense claims require receipts and must be submitted within 30 days.

title: Data protection policy
content: All employees must protect confidential information and follow data-handling guidelines. Sensitive data should only be stored in approved systems.

title: Email and communication policy
content: Email communication must remain professional. External sharing of internal documents requires manager approval.

title: How to reset your password
content: Navigate to the login page, click 'Forgot Password', enter your email address, and follow the instructions sent to your inbox.
